description: Send a buyer-intent enquiry (lead) to a tool or a whole category on AgentsIndex. Keyless. Requires consent:true, a real name, a permanent (non-disposable) email, a message of at least 20 chars, and a target (listingSlug OR categorySlug). Returns { ok, delivered }. Idempotent by (email, target) within 7 days. Nothing here changes a listing's rank, tier or copy.

consent.description: Must be true — you agree your details go to the provider(s).

message.description: The enquiry — real demand, at least 20 chars.

name: send_lead
title: Send a lead
